pr.title: Feature flag: rolling-updates

raw_findings.body: The new exit-code constant is named inconsistently with its peers (missing the _EXIT_CODE suffix), reducing readability and making the set of exit-code constants harder to discover/grep.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Maintainability degrades; the constant no longer signals it is an exit code like its siblings.
raw_findings.impact: The new exit-code constant is named inconsistently with its peers (missing the _EXIT_CODE suffix), reducing readability and making the set of exit-code constants harder to discover/grep.
raw_findings.root_cause: A new exit-code constant was introduced without following the established _EXIT_CODE naming pattern used by the adjacent constants in the same interface.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Rename the constant to FEATURE_DISABLED_EXIT_CODE to match ROLLING_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE and RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE, updating its two usages in UpdateCompatibilityCheck and UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.
raw_findings.title: New constant FEATURE_DISABLED breaks the *_EXIT_CODE naming convention of sibling constants
raw_findings.trigger: Reading or maintaining CompatibilityResult where the two other exit-code constants are named ROLLING_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE and RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE.

raw_findings.body: If ProfileTest enumerates or asserts the preview feature set, the new feature is unverified (or an existing assertion silently drifts), leaving the default-disabled state of ROLLING_UPDATES untested.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Test suite fails to cover the newly added feature's default availability.
raw_findings.impact: If ProfileTest enumerates or asserts the preview feature set, the new feature is unverified (or an existing assertion silently drifts), leaving the default-disabled state of ROLLING_UPDATES untested.
raw_findings.root_cause: A new Profile.Feature entry was introduced without updating the feature-inventory test.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Add/adjust ProfileTest to assert ROLLING_UPDATES is a PREVIEW feature and is disabled by default, keeping the feature inventory test in sync with this addition.
raw_findings.title: New ROLLING_UPDATES preview feature added without accompanying feature-list test coverage
raw_findings.trigger: ProfileTest (common/src/test/java/org/keycloak/common/ProfileTest.java) asserting expected default/preview feature sets executes against the new enum value.

finding.body: The new exit-code constant is named inconsistently with its peers (missing the _EXIT_CODE suffix), reducing readability and making the set of exit-code constants harder to discover/grep.
finding.failure_mode: Maintainability degrades; the constant no longer signals it is an exit code like its siblings.
finding.impact: The new exit-code constant is named inconsistently with its peers (missing the _EXIT_CODE suffix), reducing readability and making the set of exit-code constants harder to discover/grep.
finding.root_cause: A new exit-code constant was introduced without following the established _EXIT_CODE naming pattern used by the adjacent constants in the same interface.
finding.suggested_fix: Rename the constant to FEATURE_DISABLED_EXIT_CODE to match ROLLING_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE and RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE, updating its two usages in UpdateCompatibilityCheck and UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.
finding.title: New constant FEATURE_DISABLED breaks the *_EXIT_CODE naming convention of sibling constants
finding.trigger: Reading or maintaining CompatibilityResult where the two other exit-code constants are named ROLLING_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE and RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that FEATURE_DISABLED breaks a naming convention is incorrect. Looking at the interface, ROLLING_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE uses the _EXIT_CODE suffix because it represents a successful rolling upgrade (exit code 0), while RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE represents a recreate upgrade scenario (exit code 3). FEATURE_DISABLED (exit code 4) represents a different semantic category - it indicates the feature is disabled, not an upgrade result type. The naming is intentionally different to distinguish between upgrade compatibility results and feature availability states. This is a stylistic opinion without concrete evidence of actual harm.

FEATURE_DISABLED (exit code 4) represents a different semantic category - it indicates the feature is disabled, not an upgrade result type. The naming is intentionally different to distinguish between upgrade compatibility results and feature availability states. This is a stylistic opinion without concrete evidence of actual harm.

finding.root_cause: A new Profile.Feature entry was introduced without updating the feature-inventory test.
finding.suggested_fix: Add/adjust ProfileTest to assert ROLLING_UPDATES is a PREVIEW feature and is disabled by default, keeping the feature inventory test in sync with this addition.
finding.title: New ROLLING_UPDATES preview feature added without accompanying feature-list test coverage
finding.trigger: ProfileTest (common/src/test/java/org/keycloak/common/ProfileTest.java) asserting expected default/preview feature sets executes against the new enum value.
finding.verifier_reason: This is speculative - the candidate claims ProfileTest may need updating but provides no evidence that ProfileTest actually enumerates or asserts the preview feature set in a way that would fail. The trigger is hypothetical ('If ProfileTest enumerates...') and the confidence is low (0.3). The repository context shows ProfileTest.java exists but doesn't show its contents or that it would fail. Adding a new enum value to Profile.Feature doesn't inherently require test updates unless tests explicitly enumerate all features, which is not proven here.
